subject: planner: prepare `AccessPath.PartialAlternativeIndexPaths` to handle MV indexes (#58397)
summary: Updates planner access-path structures and OR-IndexMerge alternative handling to be MV-index-ready: `AccessPath.PartialAlternativeIndexPaths` becomes 3D (OR-branch -> alternative -> paths), cloning is adjusted, and row-count comparisons are unified for multi-path alternatives. Adds/updates tests covering IndexMerge path selection scenarios (incl. issue 58361 cases).
